Interface TestReportListener

All Superinterfaces:
Ordered, TestEventListener
All Known Implementing Classes:
HtmlTestReport, JUnitXmlReportWriter
public interface TestReportListener extends TestEventListener, Ordered
A report of the runs, registered as a service: an HTML renderer, an IDE bridge, a terminal UI. It receives the same events as the JUnit XML reports, in order, and hears of a change that did not compile, which runs no test.
